title: Optimizing Success Path with Branching Nesting (Clever Code)
pattern: Nesting execution blocks inside complex deep conditionals to prioritize a hypothetical "fast path" branch.
why_bad: Deeply nested code is highly unreadable and introduces "mental speed bumps." Modern CPU branch predictors are highly sophisticated, and compiling nested code can easily degrade instruction layout and cause branch misprediction penalties [298, 432].
detection: Nested `if` statements prioritizing a specific branch, rather than early exit guard clauses.
counterexample: Parsing nested binary format trees where structural nested checking is required. `Context-dependent`.
source: *Refactoring*, Section 1.2 (p. 298); *The Art of Readable Code*, Chapter 1 (p. 432).
